covered_report_window: Monday, August 10, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Tuesday, August 11, 2026 before the U.S. market open (America/New_York).
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near records while oil and the 10-year Treasury yield remained elevated; Strait of Hormuz uncertainty and the next U.S. CPI release increased macro, margin and valuation sensitivity.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High beat streak; cautious FY27 guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Repeated profit and cash-flow raises support a constructive FY27 setup, though fifteen straight beats raise the bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q4 EPS consensus about $2.42; FY26 adjusted EPS guide $10.70-$10.80 and adjusted FCF $3.3-$3.7B.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong FY27 EPS and specialty-profit outlook, plus GMPD recovery.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Conservative FY27 guidance, tariff pressure, or normalization of tax-assisted EPS.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Large-cap, near highs and roughly 32x trailing earnings; not squeeze-driven.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Repeated raises support estimates, but the long beat streak means the real bar is above headline consensus.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record backlog, a 1.2 design book-to-burn ratio and two consecutive guidance raises favor another resilient print.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $1.46; FY adjusted EPS guide $5.90-$6.10, EBITDA $1.275-$1.305B and organic NSR growth 6%-8%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Book-to-burn stays above 1.1, margins expand and FY guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Backlog conversion, working capital or international execution weakens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Moderate valuation and limited retail crowding improve reaction quality; no dependable event straddle was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management's two raises and record pipeline support positive estimate direction.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong commercial-foodservice growth, orders and buybacks favor upside after the July separation, with comparability the main caveat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $2.09; Q1 exceeded guidance with 8.1% commercial organic growth and management raised FY guidance before the separation.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Dealer and chain demand remain strong and segment margin holds near the investor-day framework.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Post-spin presentation noise or softer restaurant capital spending obscures execution.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down about 3% intraday, modestly improving the event bar; no reliable implied move was available.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 outperformance and higher guidance support revisions, but separated-company estimates are less comparable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High occupancy, rent and retailer-sales growth plus a prior FFO raise support a steady positive setup.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar EPS proxy about $1.69, but Real Estate FFO is decisive; FY Real Estate FFO guide is $13.10-$13.25.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NOI, rent and occupancy stay firm and the FY FFO guide rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Tenant sales soften, rates pressure valuation or management merely reiterates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Large-cap REIT with lower squeeze risk; no dependable current event straddle was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The Q1 guide and dividend moved higher, a modest positive revision signal.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Attruby launch momentum favors upside, but sequential product-revenue expectations and valuation have risen.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about -$0.58 and revenue about $223M; Q1 Attruby net product revenue was $180.6M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Attruby prescriptions, persistence and revenue clear the higher launch bar while filings stay on track.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Launch growth normalizes, payer friction appears or commercial spend widens losses.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Premium commercial-stage biotech valuation creates sell-the-news risk; no dependable event straddle was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue estimates moved up with launch momentum, while headline EPS remains secondary.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: U.S. revenue, ARPU, gross margin and EBITDA quality must recover after a sharp Q1 slowdown and GLP-1 mix shift.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus around -$0.01 to -$0.05 and revenue roughly $714M versus company guidance of $680-$700M; Q2 adjusted EBITDA guide $35-$55M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Branded GLP-1 demand, international growth and retention lift revenue above $714M and stabilize margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. demand remains weak, margins compress again or legal/regulatory commentary worsens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced about a 22% weekly move and short interest was elevated; the de-risked share price raises squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: FY EPS estimates have fallen materially; the Street revenue bar remains near or above the top of company guidance.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Retention, record new wins and productivity support continued growth and margin expansion.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.48; FY organic growth at the high end of 7%-9%, AOI growth 12%-17% and EPS growth 20%-25%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic growth exceeds 9%, new hyperscaler work enters guidance and margin expands.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Opening costs for record wins pressure margins or management only reiterates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Limited retail crowding, but a premium multiple raises the in-line hurdle.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Organic revenue guidance moved to the high end after Q2; profit targets were reiterated.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Music membership and non-membership monetization plus margin expansion outweigh the shrinking social-entertainment business.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar consensus is about RMB1.55 per ADS but unit normalization is imperfect; Q1 non-IFRS ADS EPS was RMB1.46.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: SVIP and other music revenue sustain double-digit growth and gross margin expands.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Membership growth slows, marketing/content costs rise or social revenue falls faster.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were up about 3.5% intraday, modestly raising the event bar; no dependable implied move was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 EBITDA and music-mix evidence support constructive estimates without an extreme whisper bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Shopee, Garena and Monee growth are strong, but the reaction depends on growth quality and whether Shopee profitability stops slipping.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.79-$0.82 and revenue about $7.3B; FY Shopee target is roughly 25% GMV growth with EBITDA no lower than 2025.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Shopee GMV stays near 30% while EBITDA and Monee credit quality improve.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Competitive subsidies, higher marketing or credit provisions swamp growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Large-cap ADR with meaningful event volatility; no dependable current event straddle was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 revenue beat but profit growth lagged and the key FY demand target was reiterated, not raised.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar; relief or takeover squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Recurring demand is still contracting, so ARR stabilization matters more than another cost-driven EPS beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.35; company guides ARR near $820M, revenue $207-$209M and non-GAAP EPS $0.33-$0.36.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR bottoms above $820M, platform renewals improve and FY growth commentary turns better.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ARR misses the guide or FY revenue is cut despite cost execution.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Depressed valuation limits bearish asymmetry and raises relief/takeover risk; no reliable implied move was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: ARR and revenue revisions are negative while profitability estimates are steadier.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AUA, funded accounts and profitability support upside, tempered by weaker crypto activity and trade size.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.61 versus Q1 adjusted EPS of $0.91; May AUA reached $20.1B, including acquisition effects.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Commodity/equity engagement and AUA growth keep net contribution strong.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Trade size, crypto activity or acquisition/marketing costs weaken monetization.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down roughly 4.8% intraday, de-risking the print somewhat; no dependable implied move was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Monthly AUA/account data support estimates, but acquired accounts reduce organic clarity.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cargo and Plaquemines ramp economics are strong, but the raised guide, debt, commissioning and arbitration create a high bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.48-$0.50; FY adjusted EBITDA guide $8.2-$8.5B with Plaquemines Phase I COD targeted for Q4.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cargo economics support another guide raise and COD remains firmly on schedule.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Only reiteration, weaker liquefaction fees, a COD delay or arbitration exposure dominates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were up about 6.7% intraday, materially increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1's large guide increase lifted estimates and the buy-side bar substantially.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Premium-brand demand and margin execution are strong, but the market needs a sales-guide raise rather than another profitability-only beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.34; FY constant-currency sales growth at least 23%, gross margin at least 64.5% and EBITDA margin 19.5%-20%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Sales stay above 25% and management raises the demand guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Americas, FX or tariffs weaken growth, or management reiterates sales despite a margin beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public estimates suggested roughly an 11% implied move; shares rose about 2.9% intraday.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Profit estimates rose after Q1, while the decisive sales-growth guide did not.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak legacy monetization plus Northern Data integration and capital intensity outweigh the AI-cloud narrative.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus near -$0.09 and standalone revenue around $31M; Q1 pro forma combined revenue was roughly $75M, reducing comparability.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Hyperscaler contracts, GPU utilization and MAU monetization produce a sharp low-base beat.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Integration costs, capital intensity and weak video monetization keep cash burn high.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail/political and AI narratives create substantial squeeze and manipulation risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The June transaction changed the model, leaving consensus and revisions unusually unreliable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record backlog supports the business, but Neutron timing and a demanding valuation make reaction direction too unstable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about -$0.06 to -$0.08; company Q2 revenue guide $225-$240M and adjusted EBITDA loss $20-$26M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue beats, backlog expands and Neutron Q4 timing is concretely de-risked.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Neutron slips, margins compress or acquisition funding/dilution worries rise.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail enthusiasm is intense and the stock is crowded; high volatility creates large opposite-direction risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 execution improved operating estimates, but the forward development bar rose faster.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak core marketplace demand conflicts with low valuation, AI-work growth, margins and buybacks, leaving no dependable edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about $0.34; company Q2 revenue guide $187-$193M and non-GAAP EPS $0.35-$0.37.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GSV turns positive and Business Plus/AI work scales while buybacks support EPS.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Active-client attrition continues and take-rate gains cannot offset weaker demand.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Compressed valuation and buybacks limit downside; no dependable event straddle was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: FY revenue remained soft while adjusted EBITDA guidance rose, splitting growth and efficiency signals.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Pass conflict; schedule reset or squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The August launch de-risked execution, but the remaining path toward approximately 45 satellites and beta service is highly back-end-loaded.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about -$0.29 to -$0.32, revenue about $35M and FY revenue guide $150-$200M; operations matter more than EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Firm multi-satellite launch slots and beta-service timing validate the 2026 plan.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Cadence or activation targets reset, cash burn rises or additional funding distracts.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail-heavy, high-volatility positioning and wide double-digit option ranges create strong squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue estimates assume a rapid ramp, but cadence uncertainty keeps the buy-side bar unstable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Sharp margin improvement conflicts with still-negative economics, financing history and fragile Q4 profitability credibility.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about -$0.08 and revenue about $173M; management targets positive EBITDAS in Q4.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Gross margin reaches breakeven faster and liquidity commentary reassures.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Margin stalls negative, cash burn persists or new dilution appears.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: High-beta retail positioning leaves meaningful squeeze risk in either direction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Operating estimates improved after Q1, but financing and timing uncertainty remain large.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Certification progress and liquidity are real, but pre-revenue economics and binary schedule wording overwhelm the quarter.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: EPS consensus about -$0.34; company Q2 adjusted EBITDA-loss guide $170-$200M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Concrete FAA Phase 4 milestones, defense awards or credible 2026 operations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Schedule ambiguity, burn above guide or future production capital needs.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares rose about 9% intraday on heavy volume, signaling crowded catalyst positioning.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst optimism is milestone-driven; conventional revenue revisions are not useful.
